hits.quote: Privileged-role-gated against a program exclusion: Check whether an unprivileged attacker can trigger the bug without role compromise. If not: hold. The one escape is UNKNOWING admin harm - a reasonable admin action with a non-obvious destructive second-order effect.

Impact missing or not quantified: Quantify the loss, freeze, or theft in units, percent, or currency. A year or a count of hours is not an impact figure. finding.yaml impact_usd above zero answers this.
